messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: auto-alert triggered for service `api/redwood-generate` (INCIDENT 2071234567). symptom: 95th percentile latency > 2.5s for 5m. paging on-call group @eng-oncall :rotating_light:

alice.nguyen: oncall here, pulling recent latency histograms and request logs. marking as P1 until we triage more. jumping into conference.

ben.patel: joining. initial check: saw a cluster of long tail requests hitting redwood-llama-13b-quant in us-west1 around 11:02. 5xx rate jumped to ~3% for ~7m. not seeing obvious OOMs on pods.

caroline.h: I can repro locally on a small subset with longer seqs — kv-cache miss rate spiked. suspect cached prefix eviction during rollout of model variant last night.

alice.nguyen: ops-bot, can you attach the last 30m of traces and the autoscaler events?

ops-bot: Attached: trace_link: https://traces.internal/2071234567 , autoscaler_events.log (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T11:00:01Z scale_up requested nodes=2 -> 4 reason=latency
2026-03-15T11:04:30Z scale_up completed nodes=4
2026-03-15T11:08:12Z scale_down requested nodes=4 -> 2 reason=policy
```

ben.patel: interesting — scaler brought nodes up but then policy downscaled too quickly. possible case of oscillation + cache warmup problem. for immediate mitigation: increasing reserved capacity to keep pool at 4 for next 30m and temporary fallback to redwood-llama-13b-fp16.

caroline.h: doing that now. also muting noisy alert `api_latency_95th` while we validate. will create a dedicated incident dashboard to track golden signals and drilldowns.

alice.nguyen: customer impact check — SLO blips for customers with >10s timeouts. I pulled customer metrics: ~0.6% of requests from active tenants saw >5s and ~0.03% timed out >15s. flagged support to notify SOC for any high-touch customers.

daniel.k: thumbs on runbook steps: 1) throttle large batch requests, 2) increase min nodes, 3) fallback to fp16 model variant, 4) enable longer autoscale cooldown. I'm updating runbook now.

caroline.h: dashboard plan (quick notes): add a new Grafana folder `incident-2071234567` with: - Panel A: Golden signals overview (requests/sec, error rate, p95 latency). - Panel B: Latency by model variant (stacked p50/p95) with time-range selector. - Panel C: KV cache hit/miss rate (10s resolution) with annotate on "model variant rollout" events. - Panel D: Heatmap of 5xx by endpoint and region + drilldown to logs/traces. - Panel E: Autoscaler events timeline overlayed with node counts and cache miss rate.

ben.patel: for thresholds: change `api_latency_95th` from 2.5s to 3.0s and increase evaluation window from 5m to 10m to reduce noise from short spikes. add companion alert `sustained_error_rate` that fires only if error_rate > 1.5% for 15m.

alice.nguyen: agree on threshold changes. but we should keep a low-severity alert for transient spikes (paged to channel only, not phone) so we don't miss emergent regressions.

caroline.h: created dashboard skeleton: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/incident-2071234567 (placeholder). Panel IDs: 101 (golden_signals_overview), 102 (latency_by_model), 103 (kv_cache_metrics), 104 (error_rate_heatmap), 105 (autoscaler_timeline). Adding drilldown for 102 -> trace explorer and 104 -> logql query.

alice.nguyen: nice. add a direct drilldown link for traces that captures the trace_id param from the panel. example drilldown url: `https://traces.internal/trace/${__cell:trace_id}`. make sure to include example queries in panel description for on-call.

ben.patel: I'm going to patch alerting rule now: set `for: 10m` and threshold to 3.0s, and add mute for 30m while we observe after fallback. committing patch to infra repo and triggering CI. snippet: 
```
- alert: APIHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}[5m])) by (le)) > 3.0
  for: 10m
```

caroline.h: After we stabilize, follow-ups: - add panel-level drilldowns for slow-query examples - add synthetic check for model warmup (prefix reuse) - update runbook with autoscaler cooldown recommendation (increase to 10m). assigning owners: dashboard -> caroline.h, alert patch review -> ben.patel, runbook update -> daniel.k.

alice.nguyen: support notification sent to customer success for tenants with >1% error impact. putting a short public status note on status.redwood.com: "Latency spike affecting some requests in us-west1; mitigation underway."

ops-bot: Incident 2071234567 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. muted alerts: api_latency_95th (30m). linked dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/incident-2071234567

ben.patel: monitoring looks good after fallback to fp16 variant and min nodes raised. p95 back down under 2.8s and error rate trending to baseline. I'll keep the mute window and follow up in 1h.

caroline.h: created a small follow-up ticket: INF-4921 "Dashboard + drilldowns for incident 2071234567" with checklist: add trace drilldown examples, add synthetic warmup probe, annotate rollout events. ETA EOD.

alice.nguyen: thanks team — we'll run a short retro in #eng-sre tomorrow to decide permanent alert thresholds and autoscaler cooldown defaults. closing this thread for live updates, please move any long-form notes to the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
